content.short: Crema Finance is a concentrated liquidity DeFi protocol on Solana.
content.description: Crema Finance is an established concentrated liquidity protocol anchored on the Solana blockchain, with over $2 million in total value locked and growing. In addition to its concentrated liquidity product, it distributes incentives to liquidity providers to attract more locked funds. To broaden access, Crema Finance supports additional popular blockchains to enable cross-chain swapping. Developers can leverage the Crema Finance SDK to build DApps, with the protocol serving as an oracle or infrastructure component.
